facts.fact: MZ News reports that on 23 August 2024 President Nyusi laid the first stone of the Interior Ministry's Integrated Information Centre, part of its emergency information management system project, conceived in 2015 with South Korean support, with infrastructure due by the end of 2025.

systems.system: Sistema de Informacao de Gestao de Emergencia (MINT)

MOZ.note: The project is a first stone and a plan, with its handling of citizens' requests to police in Maputo, Matola and Nampula still to come; no station records are stated.
